name: Frederick II of Denmark
role: King of Denmark and Norway from 1559 to 1588
contribution: King of Denmark and Norway and Duke of Schleswig and Holstein from 1559 until his death in 1588.

checks.lead: Frederick II (Danish: Frederik 2.; 1 July 1534 – 4 April 1588) was King of Denmark and Norway and Duke of Schleswig and Holstein from 1559 until his death in 1588.
